reason: I already invest monthly in a free broker app and ask Claude for free, so paying a monthly fee for an agent to do the same thing makes no sense to me. A demo-money pet doesn't tell me it would be worth paying for, and you won't even say what it costs.
objection: It's another subscription with no price on top of a broker partner that will probably have its own fees, and fees eat returns on index funds. I don't see what it does that my broker's auto-invest doesn't already do for free.
would_change_my_mind: A real-money version that's free, or a small flat fee clearly lower than what it saves me, with the broker partner named and no hidden trading fees.
